text: From: facility.management@oyo.com Date: 08/02 Subject: Elevator Security Update Of course! Here's a friendly and human email to inform employees of a security change. Dear employees and precious staff of OYO! As we all know, security is key, and that time of the year has come around again! We at management have observed just how high productivity has been lately, and we wouldn't want to lose that to some uninvited guests, would we? To ensure a happy and safe working environment, please take note of our newest change to elevator security! Pull out your papers, whip out your pens, and jot down our newest elevator code: 3937 Remember, this elevator is monitored for your safety! :-) Sent from my iPhone
